publish.note: Two reasons, either sufficient. No numbered address: “Two Embarcadero Center” is a complex of towers and the story gives no street number, and the module does not supply one a source never printed. And it fails the ten-year test — a tenant taking office space says nothing durable about the building.

findings.description: A one-alarm structure fire broke out on the top floor of a three-story single-family home at Laidley Street and Noa Street in Fairmount Heights around 9 a.m. Sunday, September 20; SFFD battled it. No cause or damage extent was given.

raw.text: A fire broke out on the top floor of a three-story single-family home at Laidley Street and Noa Street in San Francisco’s Fairmount Heights neighborhood around 9 a.m. Sunday.

publish.note: The costliest decline of the run: a fire is exactly what a building's timeline should carry, and this one has none of the usual problems — the headline is about the building, it names no resident, the date is firm. It fails on the address alone. Both accounts (this and the Chronicle's, 2026-09-21-sc-0002) give only the intersection of Laidley and Noa, and the module may not pick a house off a corner. Publishable the moment any source prints the number.
